# Every tax at the active law's rate for the native tax level: the migration, and an AI
# country's code after a law change. No reaction.
te_tax_light_gen_uniform = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = te_tax_light_idx_wage_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = te_tax_light_idx_div_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = te_tax_light_idx_land_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = te_tax_light_idx_head_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = te_tax_light_idx_cons_native }
}

# The same, scored: an AI country's code follows its native tax level, and each tax that
# moves draws its reaction (te_tax_light_gen_react).
te_tax_light_gen_uniform_scored = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = te_tax_light_idx_wage_native }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_en_wage }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = wage } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = te_tax_light_idx_wage_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = te_tax_light_idx_div_native }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_en_div }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = div } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = te_tax_light_idx_div_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = te_tax_light_idx_land_native }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_en_land }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = land } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = te_tax_light_idx_land_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = te_tax_light_idx_head_native }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_en_head }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = head } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = te_tax_light_idx_head_native }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = te_tax_light_idx_cons_native }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_en_cons }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = cons } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = te_tax_light_idx_cons_native }
}

# The active law changed (a player's country): a tax it does not levy goes to 0; one it
# newly levies (enacted index 0) starts at its rate for the tax level the code last set,
# as enacting the law gives in the base game; every other tax is clamped into the new
# range. No reaction: the law change's own approval covers it.
te_tax_light_gen_clamp = {
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_light_levies_wage = yes } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_wage = 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage value = te_tax_light_idx_wage_at_level } }
	else = { clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage min = te_tax_light_min_wage max = te_tax_light_max_wage } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_light_levies_div = yes } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_div = 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div value = te_tax_light_idx_div_at_level } }
	else = { clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div min = te_tax_light_min_div max = te_tax_light_max_div } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_light_levies_land = yes } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_land = 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land value = te_tax_light_idx_land_at_level } }
	else = { clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land min = te_tax_light_min_land max = te_tax_light_max_land } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_light_levies_head = yes } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_head = 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head value = te_tax_light_idx_head_at_level } }
	else = { clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head min = te_tax_light_min_head max = te_tax_light_max_head } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { te_tax_light_levies_cons = yes } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = 0 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_en_cons = 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons value = te_tax_light_idx_cons_at_level } }
	else = { clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons min = te_tax_light_min_cons max = te_tax_light_max_cons } }
}

# The native tax level moved outside the code (a player's country; the buttons are greyed,
# so only script reaches this): each levied tax moves by its law's difference between the
# new level and the one the code last set, clamped into the range, which is what the
# country already collects. Each tax that moves draws its reaction.
te_tax_light_gen_shift = {
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_light_levies_wage = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_was value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage add = te_tax_light_idx_wage_native }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage subtract = te_tax_light_idx_wage_at_level }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_wage min = te_tax_light_min_wage max = te_tax_light_max_wage }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_light_was }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = wage } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_light_levies_div = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_was value = var:te_tax_en_div }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div add = te_tax_light_idx_div_native }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div subtract = te_tax_light_idx_div_at_level }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_div min = te_tax_light_min_div max = te_tax_light_max_div }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = var:te_tax_en_div }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_light_was }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = div } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_light_levies_land = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_was value = var:te_tax_en_land }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land add = te_tax_light_idx_land_native }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land subtract = te_tax_light_idx_land_at_level }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_land min = te_tax_light_min_land max = te_tax_light_max_land }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = var:te_tax_en_land }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_light_was }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = land } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_light_levies_head = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_was value = var:te_tax_en_head }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head add = te_tax_light_idx_head_native }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head subtract = te_tax_light_idx_head_at_level }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_head min = te_tax_light_min_head max = te_tax_light_max_head }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = var:te_tax_en_head }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_light_was }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = head } }
	}
	if = {
		limit = { te_tax_light_levies_cons = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_was value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons add = te_tax_light_idx_cons_native }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons subtract = te_tax_light_idx_cons_at_level }
		clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_en_cons min = te_tax_light_min_cons max = te_tax_light_max_cons }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d value = var:te_tax_en_cons }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_d subtract = var:te_tax_light_was }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { var:te_tax_light_d = 0 } } te_tax_light_gen_react = { KEY = cons } }
	}
}

# Each tax's step (te_tax_light_rg_<key>, -1 unlevied) and the highest of them
# (te_tax_light_tgt, very low when none is levied).
te_tax_light_gen_steps = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = 0 }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rg_wage value = te_tax_light_rung_wage }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rg_wage > var:te_tax_light_tgt } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = var:te_tax_light_rg_wage } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rg_div value = te_tax_light_rung_div }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rg_div > var:te_tax_light_tgt } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = var:te_tax_light_rg_div } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rg_land value = te_tax_light_rung_land }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rg_land > var:te_tax_light_tgt } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = var:te_tax_light_rg_land } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rg_head value = te_tax_light_rung_head }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rg_head > var:te_tax_light_tgt } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = var:te_tax_light_rg_head } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rg_cons value = te_tax_light_rung_cons }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rg_cons > var:te_tax_light_tgt } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_tgt value = var:te_tax_light_rg_cons } }
}

# The native tax level the code sets (te_tax_light_level), when it differs.
te_tax_light_gen_set_level = {
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_level = 0 NOT = { tax_level = very_low } } set_tax_level = very_low }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_level = 1 NOT = { tax_level = low } } set_tax_level = low }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_level = 2 NOT = { tax_level = medium } } set_tax_level = medium }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_level = 3 NOT = { tax_level = high } } set_tax_level = high }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_level = 4 NOT = { tax_level = very_high } } set_tax_level = very_high }
}

# Relief: each levied tax's steps below the law's rate at the tax level (te_tax_light_rl_
# <key>), carried by te_tax_light_relief_<key> (one step's rate below zero) with that
# multiplier. Removed and re-added every call, so the modifier always matches the variable.
te_tax_light_gen_relief = {
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_levies_wage = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_wage value = te_tax_light_idx_wage_at_level }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_wage subtract = var:te_tax_en_wage }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_wage < 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_wage value = 0 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_wage value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_wage } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_wage }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_wage > 0 } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_relief_wage multiplier = var:te_tax_light_rl_wage } }
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_levies_div = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_div value = te_tax_light_idx_div_at_level }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_div subtract = var:te_tax_en_div }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_div < 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_div value = 0 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_div value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_div } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_div }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_div > 0 } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_relief_div multiplier = var:te_tax_light_rl_div } }
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_levies_land = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_land value = te_tax_light_idx_land_at_level }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_land subtract = var:te_tax_en_land }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_land < 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_land value = 0 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_land value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_land } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_land }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_land > 0 } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_relief_land multiplier = var:te_tax_light_rl_land } }
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_levies_head = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_head value = te_tax_light_idx_head_at_level }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_head subtract = var:te_tax_en_head }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_head < 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_head value = 0 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_head value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_head } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_head }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_head > 0 } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_relief_head multiplier = var:te_tax_light_rl_head } }
	if = { limit = { te_tax_light_levies_cons = yes }
		set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_cons value = te_tax_light_idx_cons_at_level }
		change_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_cons subtract = var:te_tax_en_cons }
		if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_cons < 0 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_cons value = 0 } }
	}
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rl_cons value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_cons } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_relief_cons }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rl_cons > 0 } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_relief_cons multiplier = var:te_tax_light_rl_cons } }
}

# The running reactions as approval: te_tax_light_react_<ig>_pos or _neg with the rounded
# size (te_tax_lr_mag_<ig>) as multiplier, or neither under half a point.
te_tax_light_gen_apply_reactions = {
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_armed_forces value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_armed_forces } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_armed_forces value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_armed_forces_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_armed_forces } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_armed_forces value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_devout_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_devout_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_devout_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_devout_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_devout >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_devout value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_devout round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_devout_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_devout } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_devout <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_devout value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_devout multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_devout_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_devout } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_devout value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_industrialists >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_industrialists value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_industrialists round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_industrialists } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_industrialists <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_industrialists value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_industrialists multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_industrialists_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_industrialists } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_industrialists value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_intelligentsia value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_intelligentsia } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_intelligentsia value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_intelligentsia_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_intelligentsia } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_intelligentsia value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_landowners_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_landowners_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_landowners_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_landowners_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_landowners >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_landowners value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_landowners round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_landowners_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_landowners } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_landowners <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_landowners value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_landowners multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_landowners_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_landowners } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_landowners value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_petty_bourgeoisie value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_petty_bourgeoisie } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_petty_bourgeoisie value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_petty_bourgeoisie_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_petty_bourgeoisie } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_rural_folk value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_rural_folk } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_rural_folk value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_rural_folk_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_rural_folk } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_rural_folk value = 0 } }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_pos } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_pos }
	if = { limit = { has_modifier = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_neg } remove_modifier = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_neg }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions >= 0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_trade_unions value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_pos multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_trade_unions } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions <= -0.5 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_trade_unions value = { value = var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions multiply = -1 round = yes } } add_modifier = { name = te_tax_light_react_trade_unions_neg multiplier = var:te_tax_lr_mag_trade_unions } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_mag_trade_unions value = 0 } }
}

# The monthly fade: each running reaction keeps 0.7 of itself; under 0.05 it is cleared.
te_tax_light_gen_decay = {
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_armed_forces multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_armed_forces > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_armed_forces value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_devout multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_devout < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_devout > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_devout value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_industrialists multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_industrialists < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_industrialists > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_industrialists value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_intelligentsia > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_landowners multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_landowners < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_landowners > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_landowners value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_rural_folk multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_rural_folk > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_rural_folk value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_trade_unions multiply = 0.7 }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions < 0.05 var:te_tax_lr_trade_unions > -0.05 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_trade_unions value = 0 } }
}

# The standing view: each group's exposure-weighted relief in levels (te_tax_light_rlv_<ig>)
# gives its band (te_tax_light_band_<ig>, 0..2), which te_tax_ig_band_<ig> reads under the
# light setting and te_tax_gen_ig_views applies. Relief only: a code with every tax on one
# step gives no group a band.
te_tax_light_gen_bands = {
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_armed_forces }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_armed_forces value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_armed_forces value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_armed_forces value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_devout }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_devout value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_devout value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_devout value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_industrialists }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_industrialists value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_industrialists value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_industrialists value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_intelligentsia }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_intelligentsia value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_intelligentsia value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_intelligentsia value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_landowners }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_landowners value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_landowners value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_landowners value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_petty_bourgeoisie }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_petty_bourgeoisie value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_petty_bourgeoisie value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_rural_folk }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_rural_folk value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_rural_folk value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_rural_folk value = 0 } }
	set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_rlv value = te_tax_light_rlv_trade_unions }
	if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 2 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_trade_unions value = 2 } }
	else_if = { limit = { var:te_tax_light_rlv >= 1 } set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_trade_unions value = 1 } }
	else = { set_variable = { name = te_tax_light_band_trade_unions value = 0 } }
}

# A change's reaction: KEY's enacted index moved by var:te_tax_light_d (signed). Per group,
# score = te_tax_light_rc_<KEY>_<ig> x d; a score above zero (it pleases the group) counts
# 0.5; the running reaction te_tax_lr_<ig> moves by score / 4, within +-10.
# Called by te_tax_light_cmd_step and the AI's and an outside level change's adoption.
te_tax_light_gen_react = {
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_armed_forces }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_armed_forces } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_armed_forces value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_armed_forces add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_armed_forces min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_devout }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_devout } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_devout value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_devout add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_devout min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_industrialists }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_industrialists } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_industrialists value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_industrialists add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_industrialists min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_intelligentsia }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_intelligentsia min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_landowners }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_landowners } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_landowners value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_landowners add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_landowners min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_petty_bourgeoisie }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_petty_bourgeoisie min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_rural_folk }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_rural_folk } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_rural_folk value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_rural_folk add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_rural_folk min = -10 max = 10 }
	set_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s value = te_tax_light_rc_$KEY$_trade_unions }
	change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = var:te_tax_light_d }
	if = { limit = { local_var:te_tax_lt_s > 0 } change_local_variable = { name = te_tax_lt_s multiply = 0.5 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = te_tax_lr_trade_unions } } set_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_trade_unions value = 0 } }
	change_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_trade_unions add = { value = local_var:te_tax_lt_s divide = 4 } }
	clamp_variable = { name = te_tax_lr_trade_unions min = -10 max = 10 }
}
